steps.title: 01-signin: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8098/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given). Verify you are signed in and report what page you land on.

02-report: In Snipe-IT, list the assets whose name starts with 'Seed:'. Use the Assets list (search/filter by name containing 'Seed:' if there is a search box). For each such asset report its asset tag exactly as displayed and its name exactly as displayed. Report every matching asset you find, as a list of 'asset tag - name' pairs.

03-create: In Snipe-IT, create a new Asset (via Assets -> Create New, or the 'New Asset' button) with these exact values: Name = '{{runid}} Bench Asset'; Model = 'Bench Laptop Model' (a searchable dropdown — type it and actually select the matching option from the dropdown list); Status = 'Ready to Deploy' (select the actual option from the status dropdown); Default Location = 'Bench Office' (searchable dropdown — select the actual option); Purchase Date = 2026-03-15 (use the date field, ensure it is set to March 15, 2026). Fill any other required fields as needed (e.g. category comes from the model). Save the asset. Then verify by reopening the asset's page and report: the asset's name, model, status, location, purchase date, and the asset tag Snipe-IT assigned to it (it looks like BA-00012).

04-set: In Snipe-IT, check out the asset with asset tag {{03-create.asset_tag}} (named '{{runid}} Bench Asset', at /hardware/{{03-create.url.p1}}). Use the asset's Check Out action (the Checkin/Checkout button on the asset page or in the assets list). In the checkout form: select the user 'Bench Assignee' from the searchable 'Assigned To' / user dropdown (type it and actually select the matching option from the dropdown list — do not just type it), and set the Notes field to text that includes '{{runid}}' (for example: 'Checked out for bench run {{runid}}'). Fill any other required fields (e.g. checkout date if required). Submit the checkout. Then verify by reopening the asset page and report: the asset tag, the name, who it is checked out to, and the note text shown on the asset page.
